revisions.goal: Make PR #36 and similar eve branches remain current when a completed Snapshot is followed only by its required eve history commit, regardless of unrelated target-branch movement.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Reproduce the PR #36 topology where a branch contains earlier feature commits and Snapshots, then a latest implementation Snapshot and a final .eve-only record commit. 2. The latest Snapshot is classified current when no product commit follows it, even if the PR merge-base predates that Snapshot's base commit. 3. PR #36 appears in the eve review queue when it has a Plan reference. 4. A later product change or a product-changing target merge remains stale. 5. The PR detail shows the real GitHub merge-conflict blocker rather than Review stale. 6. Relevant Go/UI tests and builds pass.

milestones.title: Reproduce PR #36 topology
milestones.goal: Add and run a deterministic regression that fails with Review stale / missing queue context.

milestones.title: Correct history-only matching
milestones.goal: Separate harmless eve record commits from target-merge product-delta validation.

milestones.title: Verify queue and detail status
milestones.goal: Run focused and full tests plus browser verification against PR #36.
